args.summary: Fixed 4 errors: (1) Inputs!B10 D&A%-of-revenue was 3.00, should be 0.03. (2) Revenue!D2:G2 retail growth referenced blank Inputs!C5:F5 instead of Inputs!$B$5, stalling retail growth after Year1. (3) PnL!C9:G9 tax was computed on EBITDA (C6) instead of EBIT (C8) per spec "tax on operating profit after D&A". (4) DCF!B7 Gordon-growth terminal value divided by WACC alone instead of (WACC - g).
